name: Skittering Blood
summary: Skittering Blood feeds the Royal Apothecary Society's work on a New Plague. The reagent comes from arachnids in the Skittering Dark of Silverpine Forest, where Forsaken alchemists seek a weapon against the Scourge and humanity.

sections.title: A Toxic Distillate
sections.body: Skitterweb lurkers, strikers, and their broodmother Krethis the Shadowspinner yield a venomous blood. Apothecary Renferrel found that, refined with toxins from grizzled bear hearts, it forms the base of an exceptionally lethal elixir. Its contaminating agents make it useful in the Apothecarium's chemical experiments.

sections.title: Fueling the New Plague
sections.body: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell directs the Royal Apothecary Society's search for a New Plague. The Forsaken face Scourge hordes and hostile human remnants, and turn to biological warfare to even the odds. Faranell studies the blood's toxic strength as he works toward a contagion that can destroy unlife and living flesh alike.

faq.q: What is Skittering Blood used for?
aliases: what does faranell do with skittering blood
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society uses Skittering Blood in its work on the Forsaken's New Plague. Blended with toxins from bear hearts, it makes a volatile mixture that Master Apothecary Faranell studies for use against the Scourge and living humans.
Skittering Blood comes from Skitterweb lurkers, strikers, and Krethis the Shadowspinner in and around the Skittering Dark, a gloomy, web-choked wood in northwestern Silverpine Forest.
Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest asks for the blood. The gathered fluid is delivered to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity's Apothecarium.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken need venom from local beasts?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society draws natural toxins from Lordaeron's corrupted fauna. Venom from Silverpine's giant arachnids provides raw biological pathogens that can be concentrated and weaponized into synthetic plagues.

angles.text: As an Undead, your contribution of Skittering Blood aids Queen Sylvanas and the Royal Apothecary Society as they develop a biological weapon against Arthas and living humanity.
As Horde, you help Forsaken apothecaries secure Lordaeron with weapons of their own making in their war against the Scourge.
